violations.text: Dishes and utensils were observed in the back hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Pan was removed from the sink at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

Marinara Sauce, which was previously cooked and cooled, was placed in the steam hot hold unit for reheating and observed at 105 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food that is cooked, cooled, and reheated for hot holding must be reheated rapidly to 165 degrees Fahrenheit or above for 15 seconds. Marinara Sauce was moved to the cooktop for rapid reheating at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the back hand sink were observed to have an accumulation of dry ingredients dust and food residue. Nonfood contact surfaces of equipment are to be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean and preclude the buildup of food and debris. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

Dishes/equipment were observed in the kitchen hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Equipment was removed from the hand sink at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The front pizza prep kitchen area does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. Hand sink is to be installed in the pizza prep area. Plan for installation of a hand sink is to be submitted to inspector. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (deli slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Deli slicer was disassembled for proper cleaning and sanitizing at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Recently prepped marinara was observed held at 117 degrees Fahrenheit in the steam unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Marinara was moved to the cooktop for proper reheating, and the steam table was adjusted to a higher setting at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Cheese that was just shredded prior to inspection was observed stored in covered 6" deep containers in the reach-in cooler at 56 degrees Fahrenheit. Proper cooling of food items was discussed with employees at the time of inspection. Cheese was rearranged for proper cooling at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Pizza cutters were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Proper storage of in-use utensils was discussed at time of inspection. Pizza cutters were removed from standing water for proper storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (prep table) have a small amount of droppings and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026

The facility is lacking a mop sink. At least one mop sink or one curbed cleaning facility equipped with a floor drain must be provided and conveniently located for the cleaning of mops or similar wet floor cleaning tools and for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the storage area near refrigeration. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2026
